Name: A Bigger Better Hilltop
Author: XCube591
Description:
[center][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/5k5sF32.gif[/img]﻿

This mod ads a medium sized space on the right side of the farm, it also does the following:
[/b]
- Adds a staircase from Grandpas grave to mining area ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿    ﻿ ﻿      ﻿
- Moves the pond from the left bottom corner to the right bottom corner ﻿ ﻿ ﻿   ﻿
- Changes all the bridges to stone ones ﻿ ﻿ ﻿   ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿
- Adds a grassy area above the Farmhouse for storage ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿       ﻿ ﻿ ﻿  
- A few visual improvements - a tunnel and a new higher level as a part of the map extension

[b]How to install:[/b]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿     
2. Extract the zip file inside the Mods folder in Your Stardew Valley directory﻿ ﻿     ﻿ ﻿      
3. Install Reset Terrain Features mod and after entering the game, reset bushes﻿ ﻿    ﻿ ﻿ 
4. All done! ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿
